Compliance Rate (Warnings and Violations) by Region

Compliance rate = the percentage of datasets that are completely clean in a run: no warnings and no violations (summed over all timestamps). Only datasets that were validated for that region in that run are counted. Combined counts every region–dataset pair together, so it is not the average of the region columns.\nFormula: compliance rate = (number of clean datasets ÷ number of validated datasets) × 100. Example: 8 clean datasets out of 21 → 8 ÷ 21 × 100 = 38.10 %. The datasets are counted on the "Compliance basis" sheet.
